name: OSRS PvM Consumables Index
description: Equal-weighted, liquidity-capped basket of potions, food and combat runes. The healthiest of the four baskets by some distance: unit volumes run into the tens of millions, buy limits are generous (2,000-25,000), and spreads are homogeneous around 1.6%. Tracks the running cost of endgame PvM rather than the capital cost of gearing for it.
notes: Consumables are structurally different from gear: supply is produced continuously by players rather than dropped, so prices track production cost and PvM activity instead of drop-rate accumulation. Expect a different drift sign from the gear baskets.
Ranging potion(4) is the thinnest leg at 1.0B gp/24h and 4.2M gp per 4h window; it sits right on the screen boundary and should be watched.
Blood and Death runes are the only sub-1000gp items retained. They clear the 50gp floor comfortably and their unit volumes (60M and 46M per day) make bucket-level manipulation impractical.

The candidate pool is deliberately larger than target_size. Membership is decided each review by liquidity rank with entry/exit buffers, so the pool defines what the basket is ABOUT while the rules decide what it HOLDS. Curation cannot be automated away: the API has no item taxonomy.
